text:
Dana Ortiz: Quick follow-up from the PM: recurring memory growth across long-running workers. We need firm owners for the remediation items + JIRA links. Please RACI and ETA by EOD.
Evan Brooks: I'll take the heap-profiling action and the hotfix for the retention window. I'll open tickets and ping @Leila for review. ETA: +3 working days.
Leila Ahmed: I'll own the canary lifecycle change and add the proactive alerts. Will create tickets and draft acceptance criteria. ETA: +5 days.
Evan Brooks: Created RED-22020 (heap profiling) and RED-22021 (hotfix retention). Links: https://jira.redwood/RED-22020
Leila Ahmed: Created RED-22022 (canary lifecycle) and RED-22023 (alert tuning). Links: https://jira.redwood/RED-22022
Dana Ortiz: Need RACI on each. Proposal:
- RED-22020: R=Evan, A=Evan, C=Leila, I=Platform
- RED-22021: R=Evan, A=Dana, C=Eng SRE, I=Support
- RED-22022: R=Leila, A=Leila, C=Evan, I=QA
- RED-22023: R=Leila, A=Dana, C=Observability, I=Product
Leila Ahmed: Fine with that, but would prefer A=Leila on RED-22023 if Dana prefers to be informed rather than accountable.
Dana Ortiz: I'll stay I for RED-22023. I'll be A on the hotfix (RED-22021) to expedite approvals.
ops-bot: Automated: Postmortem linked -> https://postmortems.redwood/4823456789; Suggested follow-up template attached.
Evan Brooks: Adding acceptance criteria for RED-22020:
```
- End-to-end heap profile captured for 24h run in staging
- Memory regression < 10% vs baseline
- PR with fix + perf test passing
```
Leila Ahmed: For RED-22022 acceptance:
```
- Canary window extended to 2h for long-tail jobs
- Automatic rollback triggers on >3% sustained leak
- Dashboard panels added for worker RSS and GC pause
```
Dana Ortiz: Timelines summary:
- RED-22020 (heap profiling) 1 days? Actually +3 working days (Evan)
- RED-22021 (hotfix) 
+2 days (owner Evan, A=Dana)
- RED-22022 (canary) 
+5 days (Leila)
- RED-22023 (alerts) 
+4 days (Leila)
Dana Ortiz: Action: Everyone, put the JIRA links in the PM doc and add the RACI table. I'll run a quick checkpoint tomorrow morning at 10:15am PST in the PM channel. If anything changes, update the ticket and ping me here.
Evan Brooks: Copy. I'll link perf artifacts in RED-22020 once available.
Leila Ahmed: Will post dashboard mockups in RED-22022 and tag the observability team.
Dana Ortiz: Thanks. If we hit scope creep, let's surface in the checkpoint; avoid scope bloat unless critical. :thumbsup:
